Redragon K617 Fizz 60% Wired RGB Mechanical Gaming Keyboard

 The Redragon K617 Fizz 60% Wired RGB Mechanical Gaming Keyboard stands as an iconic favorite in the competitive esports community, engineered specifically for FPS players, minimal setup enthusiasts, and mobile gamers who demand ultra-fast mechanical responsiveness, compact portability, and rich customization. By trimming away unnecessary outer bezel bulk and peripheral keys, this 61-key powerhouse provides maximum desktop freedom, allowing for sweeping low-DPI mouse flicks in fast-paced shooter environments like Valorant, Counter-Strike, and Apex Legends.

 Optimized to elevate any modern gaming battle station or compact streaming setup, the Redragon K617 Fizz combines a sleek, dual-color aesthetic with rugged build quality. Featuring hot-swappable linear mechanical switches, vibrant RGB Chroma backlighting, a detachable Type-C cable line, and full driver software remapping, this nimble keyboard delivers the instant keystroke execution, tactile comfort, and customizable authority needed to dominate every match.

 
 
 
 
 Ultra-Compact 60% Layout (61 Keys)

 Maximized Desk Space for Unobstructed Low-DPI Mouse Sweeps

 Featuring a streamlined 60% percent compact framework with 61 keys , the K617 Fizz minimizes its desktop footprint to give your gaming mouse pad optimal room for wide, uninterrupted tracking sweeps. By eliminating the traditional number pad, function row, and navigation cluster, this space-saving design drastically improves overall arm ergonomics, keeping your hands closer together to reduce shoulder strain during multi-hour gaming marathons.

 Despite its compact size, all essential navigational and multimedia functions remain easily accessible via intuitive key combinations using the dedicated Function (Fn) key layer, ensuring zero loss in daily operational utility.

 
 Hot-Swappable Quiet Linear Red Switches

 Smooth, Effortless Keystrokes with Modular Customization Freedom

 Equipped out of the box with custom-tuned linear Red mechanical switches , the K617 Fizz provides a buttery-smooth, quiet downward stroke with zero tactile bump or loud clicking noise. With a light actuation force requirement, these switches respond instantly to subtle finger movements, allowing competitive players to execute rapid double-taps, strafe adjustments, and skill combinations effortlessly.

 The PCB features hot-swappable 3-pin switch sockets, giving you the freedom to pull out and replace switches on the fly without ever touching a soldering iron. This allows you to easily customize your typing feel or swap in alternative MX-style mechanical switches down the road.

 
 Vibrant Chroma RGB Backlighting & Dynamic Effects

 20+ Preset Lighting Modes with Full Software Customization

 Inject captivating visual energy directly onto your desk with the vibrant, integrated RGB Chroma backlighting system . The K617 Fizz features up to 20 pre-installed dynamic lighting modes, including rainbow wave, breathing, reactive trigger, and solid color profiles, switchable instantly using onboard key shortcuts.

 Through the dedicated Redragon software driver, players can further customize lighting effects, adjust brightness levels, modify transition speeds, or configure key-by-key custom illumination themes to perfectly match their room’s setup aesthetic.

 
 Detachable USB Type-C Cable & Travel-Ready Portability

 Convenient Plug-and-Play Design for Easy Transport to Tournaments

 Designed with portability in mind, the keyboard includes a high-durability, detachable USB Type-C cable line with an L-shaped connector interface. This side-mounted connector orientation keeps the cable neatly routed away from your mouse pad while preventing accidental port strain during intense gameplay.

 The detachable design makes packing up the keyboard for LAN parties, esports tournaments, or travel exceptionally simple, eliminating cable tangle and protecting the connection port during transport.

Redragon K617 Fizz Magnetic RGB 8K Rapid Trigger Gaming Keyboard

 The Redragon K617 Fizz Magnetic RGB Rapid Trigger Gaming Keyboard represents a high-speed leap forward in competitive esports hardware, specifically engineered for tactical FPS players and rhythm game enthusiasts who demand instantaneous input registration and total movement authority. By upgrading the iconic 60% Fizz framework with advanced Hall Effect magnetic switch mechanics, this compact powerhouse completely eliminates traditional physical contact delays and fixed reset points. Every subtle stroke of your fingertips is scanned continuously by electromagnetic sensors, translating your physical reflexes into instant, pixel-perfect in-game actions.

 Optimized to anchor minimal PC gaming battle stations, competitive tournament rigs, and high-energy streaming spaces, the Redragon K617 Magnetic combines hyper-fast execution with massive desktop space savings. Featuring a massive 8,000Hz (8K) hyper-polling rate, dynamic Rapid Trigger (RT) technology, customizable actuation travel points, and vibrant RGB Chroma backlighting, this magnetic weapon provides the competitive edge needed to dominate ranked leaderboards in Valorant, Counter-Strike 2, and Apex Legends.

 
 
 
 
 Hall Effect Magnetic Switches & Rapid Trigger Tech

 Customizable Key Sensitivity Calibrated from 0.1mm to 4.0mm

 At the core of the Redragon K617 Magnetic are custom-tuned Hall Effect linear magnetic switches . Unlike standard mechanical switches that rely on physical metallic contact plates touching to register a keystroke, these electromagnetic switches measure exact magnet distance continuously. This eliminates mechanical debounce delay and physical switch wear, ensuring millions of ultra-responsive keystrokes without double-clicking issues.

 Combined with Rapid Trigger (RT) technology via the driver software, keys activate and deactivate dynamically the micro-instant your finger changes direction. Players can adjust actuation points with 0.1mm precision between 0.1mm and 4.0mm, allowing for instant counter-strafing, stopping on a dime to lock down crosshair stability, and firing hyper-accurate first bullets.

 Engineered for pure speed, the K617 Magnetic features Redragon’s advanced 8,000Hz (8K) hyper-polling rate core . Transmitting data to your PC up to 8 times faster than standard 1000Hz gaming keyboards, the input response latency is reduced down to an incredible 0.125ms.

 Connected via a heavy-duty detachable USB-C cable line, this hyper-polling pipeline guarantees that your movement commands, weapon swaps, and ability triggers register instantly on screen, giving you the pre-action advantage in fast-paced firefights.

 
 Dual-Action Key Binding (DKS / 2-in-1 Tap)

 Assign Multiple Game Actions to a Single Key Based on Press Depth

 Take full advantage of analog magnetic travel depth with Dynamic Keypress (DKS) functionality . Using the configuration driver, players can assign two distinct actions to a single key press based on depth—for example, light press to walk silently, and a full bottom-out press to sprint.

 This feature simplifies complex key combination chains in tactical shooters and action RPGs, letting you execute multi-step movement routines effortlessly with a single finger movement.

 Double Bracket and Side Lights

 Fn Core Key

Redragon FLEKACT K708GG-RGB-PRO 

 This is an advanced 75% mechanical keyboard, designed for users who value both functionality and personalization. Equipped with modern technologies such as intelligent LCD display, flexible Gasket Mount design and Hot-Swap function, this keyboard combines comfort, versatility and unique customization options. With three connection modes (wired and wireless) and fully customizable RGB backlighting, the FLEKACT K708GG-RGB-PRO is perfect for both work and play, offering an unrivaled user experience. 

 
 Multifunctional LCD Display and Knob 

 
 The FLEKACT K708GG-RGB-PRO keyboard is distinguished by a built-in intelligent LCD display and a dedicated knob, which significantly facilitate setting management and monitoring the device's condition. The LCD display shows key information such as battery level, operating mode (Windows/Mac), active connection (wired, 2.4G, Bluetooth). The knob, on the other hand, allows you to quickly adjust the brightness of the backlight, adjust the volume, and change backlight modes, which makes everyday use of the keyboard more intuitive and pleasant. 

 

 
 Flexible Gasket Design 

 
 The keyboard is designed using the Gasket Mount design, which combines flexibility with robustness. The Redragon FLEKACT design provides exceptional writing comfort, minimizing fatigue even during long use sessions. Each keystroke is palpably soft yet precise, making writing a pleasure. The Gasket Mount design also effectively dampens vibrations, which translates into quieter keyboard operation and is more pleasant to the ear. 

 

 
 Three Connection Modes 

 
 FLEKACT K708GG-RGB-PRO offers three different connection modes: wired via Type-C cable, wireless via Bluetooth (3.0 and 5.0 versions) and 2.4GHz wireless connection. This versatility makes it easy for you to customize your keyboard for a variety of – situations, from desk work to on-the-go use. Switching between modes is simple and fast thanks to dedicated buttons on the side of the keyboard. 

 

 
 Leopard Switches with Hot-Swap Function 

 
 FLEKACT K708GG-RGB-PRO is standardly equipped with Leopard switches, which are characterized by smooth and quiet operation, without a noticeable activation point. Linear switches are ideal for people who prefer fast, smooth keystrokes, which works well for both heavy typing and gaming. It is also equipped with a Hot-Swap function, which allows you to easily replace switches without the need for soldering. With this feature, you can replace factory-installed switches with others at any time, adapting the keyboard to your preferences. This is especially useful for users who like to experiment with different types of switches or want to adapt the keyboard to specific needs, for example by changing the switches to more quiet or more noticeable ones.

The Razer Huntsman Tournament Edition is a compact high-performance esports gaming keyboard built for players who demand maximum speed, fast response times, and tournament-ready portability. Designed and tested alongside Team Razer esports athletes, this keyboard focuses heavily on competitive gaming performance using Razer’s ultra-fast Linear Optical Switches combined with premium doubleshot PBT keycaps and a tenkeyless design.

 Razer Linear Optical Switches

 The Huntsman Tournament Edition uses Razer Linear Optical Switches designed for ultra-fast actuation and near-instant responsiveness. Unlike traditional mechanical switches that rely on physical metal contact, Razer optical switches use light-based actuation for faster signal registration and reduced debounce delay.

 With a 1.0mm actuation point and smooth linear feel, the keyboard is optimized for:

 Competitive FPS games

Valorant

Counter-Strike 2

Fortnite

Apex Legends

Fast reaction gameplay

Esports tournaments

 The switches are also rated for up to 100 million keystrokes, ensuring long-term durability for heavy gaming use.

 Compact Tenkeyless Layout

 The keyboard features a Tenkeyless (TKL) design, meaning the numpad has been removed to create a more compact layout. This provides:

 More mouse movement space

Better arm positioning

Cleaner desk setups

Easier transportation

Tournament portability

 Many professional esports players prefer TKL keyboards because they allow wider mouse movement for low-sensitivity aiming setups.

 Premium Doubleshot PBT Keycaps

 Unlike standard ABS keycaps found on many gaming keyboards, the Huntsman TE includes premium doubleshot PBT keycaps designed for improved durability and long-term texture retention.

 Benefits include:

 More durable surface

Better texture and grip

Oil resistance

Reduced shine over time

Long-lasting legends

 The keyboard also uses a standard bottom row layout, making aftermarket keycap customization much easier for enthusiasts.

 Detachable USB-C Cable

 LAN tournaments

Gaming events

Portable setups

Cleaner desk organization

Easier storage and transport

 The cable locking mechanism helps maintain stable connectivity during gameplay.

 Razer Chroma RGB Lighting

 The keyboard supports full per-key Razer Chroma RGB lighting with millions of customizable colors and effects. Through Razer Synapse software, users can:

 Customize individual keys

Sync RGB with games

Create custom profiles

Synchronize lighting with other Razer devices

Use advanced Chroma Studio effects

 The RGB system integrates with hundreds of supported games and applications for immersive lighting effects.

 Onboard Memory and Gaming Features

 The Huntsman TE includes onboard profile storage that allows users to save settings directly on the keyboard. Users can activate up to 5 onboard profiles without requiring software installation.

 Additional gaming features include:

 N-key rollover

Anti-ghosting

Gaming mode

On-the-fly macro recording

Fully programmable keys

1000Hz polling rate

 These features help maximize responsiveness and gaming precision during competitive play.

 Fast and Responsive Gaming Experience

 The Huntsman Tournament Edition is widely praised for its speed and responsiveness. Community feedback often highlights how sensitive and fast the optical switches feel during gaming.

 Fast-paced shooters

Competitive esports

Rapid key combinations

Reaction-based gameplay

Tournament environments

 The HyperX Alloy Origins 65 is a masterful blend of compactness and functionality, ensuring that you never have to compromise on performance. Its 65% form factor is smaller than a tenkeyless keyboard while still providing essential arrow keys for effortless navigation. Built with a durable, full aircraft-grade aluminum body, this keyboard not only looks sleek but is also designed to withstand intense gaming sessions. The HyperX mechanical switches are rated for an impressive 80 million keypresses, offering reliability alongside its compact design.

 The stock double shot PBT keycaps feature secondary functions printed on the sides, allowing for quick access to additional functionalities. With the exposed LED design of the HyperX switches, your style can shine through with vibrant RGB lighting effects. You can further personalize your experience using the HyperX NGENUITY software, which allows for the creation of macros, custom lighting profiles, and much more.

 Key Features:

 
• 
 Functionally Compact 65% Form Factor: Optimized for a balance of space-saving design and essential functionality, the 65% layout frees up valuable mouse space while retaining dedicated arrow keys, Page Up/Down, Home, and Delete keys.

• 
 Full Aircraft-Grade Aluminum Body: The robust aluminum casing ensures structural integrity and stability, even during the most intense gaming moments.

• 
 Premium Double Shot PBT Keycaps: Crafted from durable PBT material, these keycaps are resistant to wear, friction, and solvents. The side-printed secondary functions enable quick identification and access.

• 
 HyperX Mechanical Switches: Designed for a responsive and tactile experience, these switches ensure consistent performance and durability.

• 
 RGB Backlit Keys with Radiant Lighting Effects: Experience enhanced visibility with bright, vibrant RGB lighting made possible by the exposed LED design of the HyperX switches.

• 
 Advanced Customization with HyperX NGENUITY Software: Tailor your keyboard experience by configuring Game Mode, creating macros, and setting up per-key lighting and effects to match your style.

• 
 Adjustable Angles and Detachable USB-C Cable: The keyboard features two-step feet for three adjustable tilt angles, while the detachable USB-C cable enhances portability for gamers on the go.

• 
 Included Keycap Puller and Extra Keycaps: Customize your keyboard further with the included keycap puller, an additional Esc key, and a special alternate spacebar design for the Alloy Origins 65.

igeek-1wpuog3.description:
Technical aspects. 

 
• Ultracompact mechanical gaming keyboard

• 25-key GLOBAL layout with super stunning “oversized” lettering

• Gateron™ G Pro mechanical switches

• Cherry™ profile (heights & shaping) keycaps

• RGB illumination with a bunch of cool effects

• Padded and textured magnetic wrist rest

• Cool gadgety knobs

• Multimedia controls

• Fn-layer (dual function keys)

• USB-C connector

• Compatibility: Desktop PC and gaming laptops, PS4/PS5 (standard HID compliant USB device)

 
 I know what you are thinking. You are questioning whether this keyboard is worthwhile. After all, what’s the use of a keyboard if you can’t use it to type? Well, you would be right, and in any other circumstance, I’d totally agree. However, this incredible device works perfectly for the job it is designed for. That job is to be a simple and straightforward gaming peripheral.

 As such, the oversized buttons were a great design choice. What’s more, the use of Gateron™ G Pro switches to dampen that traditional mechanical sound was a wise design. Moreover, the Cherry profile for the keycaps ensures that the lower position is more responsive and feels more comfortable. Keeping with the button elements, the inclusion of dual-aspect functionality was a stroke of genius. Subsequently, the manufacturers have been able to incorporate many essential keys without jeopardising their design aspirations.

 For example, the FN and ESC buttons mirror the enter key. While FN and 1 through 5 represent F1 to F5. This was a sensible approach, as many gamers require a vast choice of keys for their in-depth gaming experiences. Accordingly, they can’t complain about usability or functionality. On top of this, The Shrimp Model 1 incorporates media shortcuts at the touch of a button. You can adjust the audio levels, mute sound, or skip and pause tracks at will. This was great as you are in total control without having to alter your settings or play around with your PC.

 
 

 Usability. 

 Technically, The Shrimp Model 1 is phenomenal. It is responsive, easy to use, looks great, and is built to last. But, what about its usability? How does this tiny keyboard compare to other market-leading devices? I’ve been able to look at the , the , and the As such, I have a good understanding of the keyboard market. Accordingly, this device is a little restrictive compared to its peers. Without the full range of keys, it takes some getting used to. However, once you accept its limitations, you experience a phenomenal device.

 When you team this up with a mappable gaming mouse, such as the you get a winning combination. No longer do you need to worry about keyboard inputs as your mouse takes the load. Instead, you can enjoy the simplicity and the minimal nature of this accessory. Moreover, you can sit back and enjoy the insane light show from the RGB setup.

 

 This is one hell of a niche product. However, those who buy it will absolutely love everything about it. From its quirky and dated style to its incredibly easy and functional usability, this is a top-notch accessory. Yes, it takes some getting used to, and it won’t be suitable for every occasion, but this matters not. Why? Well, most gamers already have a great keyboard, and The Shrimp Model 1 will simply be an awesome addition to your setup.

 On top of this, its build quality is phenomenal, and its RGB lighting is enhanced thanks to the larger buttons. Furthermore, the excellent and striking magnetic wrist support ensures that it’s comfortable to use for extended gaming sessions. I understand that hardcore gamers may overlook this, but Nordic Game Supply has something up its sleeves to counteract this. As such, keep an eye on their website for some exciting product news. On the whole, The Shrimp Model 1 more than exceeded my expectations. Subsequently, I am happy to recommend that you buy it

 Revolutionary Analog Optical Switches

 The biggest feature of the Razer Huntsman V2 Analog is its advanced Analog Optical Switch technology. Unlike traditional mechanical switches that only detect simple on/off inputs, these analog switches can register varying levels of pressure similar to a joystick or controller trigger.

 This allows:

 Variable movement control

Adjustable actuation sensitivity

Dual-step key functions

More precise gaming inputs

Faster reaction times

 Gamers can customize actuation points between 1.5mm and 3.6mm depending on their preferred playstyle and game type. Competitive players can configure ultra-light activation for faster response times, while other users may prefer deeper actuation for improved accuracy and accidental press prevention.

 True Analog Gaming Experience

 One of the most unique features of the Huntsman V2 Analog is its ability to simulate analog joystick movement directly from keyboard keys. This creates smoother directional control in supported games instead of the traditional rigid 8-direction WASD movement found on normal keyboards.

 This feature is especially useful for:

 Racing games

Flight simulators

Open-world games

RPG games

Competitive shooters

Movement-heavy esports titles

 Players gain more natural and fluid movement control while still keeping the precision and familiarity of a keyboard setup.

 Ultra Fast Optical Performance

 Razer optical switch technology uses light-based actuation instead of traditional metal contact systems. This dramatically improves response speed and durability while reducing debounce delay.

 Benefits include:

 Faster key registration

Reduced input latency

Improved gaming responsiveness

Better reliability

Smoother rapid key presses

 For competitive gaming, these performance advantages can provide more responsive gameplay during fast-paced matches.

 Premium Gaming Build Quality

 Aluminum top frame

Premium textured finish

Durable optical switches

 Games

 Dedicated Media Controls and Smart Features

SteelSeries Apex Pro Mini – The World’s Fastest Gaming Keyboard in a Compact 60% Form Factor

 There are gaming keyboards, and then there is the SteelSeries Apex Pro Mini . While every other keyboard locks you into a fixed actuation point, the Apex Pro Mini gives you something no other keyboard on the planet can offer — the ability to adjust how your switches feel and respond , customized to your exact preference. Featuring SteelSeries’ revolutionary OmniPoint 2.0 Adjustable Magnetic Switches, a 60% compact layout that frees up your entire desk, and a feature set that rivals keyboards twice its price, the Apex Pro Mini is the keyboard that redefines what performance gaming hardware can be.

 Available now at White Angel Computers Jordan — your number one destination for gaming peripherals and PC accessories in the Kingdom.

 
 OmniPoint 2.0 Adjustable Magnetic Switches – No Other Keyboard Does This

 The defining feature that sets the Apex Pro Mini apart from every other keyboard ever made is its OmniPoint 2.0 Adjustable Magnetic Switches . Unlike traditional mechanical switches that have a fixed actuation point determined by the manufacturer, the OmniPoint 2.0 switches allow you to adjust the actuation distance from 0.2mm to 3.8mm — giving you complete control over how sensitive and responsive your keyboard feels.

 Set your actuation to 0.2mm for the fastest, most hair-trigger response possible — ideal for competitive FPS and battle royale games where split-second reactions determine whether you live or die. Set it to 3.8mm for a deeper, more deliberate feel that reduces accidental keypresses — perfect for typing, strategy games, and precise inputs. Or find your perfect middle ground anywhere in between.

 This level of customization has never existed in a keyboard before the Apex Pro. Every other keyboard asks you to accept the switches as they are. The Apex Pro Mini asks you what you want them to be.

 The OmniPoint 2.0 switches are also magnetic rather than mechanical, meaning there are no physical contact points to wear out over time. The switches are rated for an extraordinary 100 million keypresses , making them virtually indestructible compared to standard mechanical switches rated for 50 million or less.

 
 Dual Actuation – Two Actions on One Keypress

 The Apex Pro Mini takes switch customization even further with an exclusive Dual Actuation feature that allows you to assign two different actions to a single keypress at different actuation depths. For example, you could set a light tap at 0.5mm to trigger one action and a full press at 3.0mm to trigger a completely different action — effectively doubling the functionality of every key on your keyboard.

 In gaming terms, this opens up entirely new possibilities for keybinding optimization. Assign walk to a light tap and sprint to a full press of the same key. Trigger one ability at a shallow press and a different ability at a deep press. The creative potential for Dual Actuation to transform your gameplay efficiency is virtually limitless and completely unique to the Apex Pro lineup.

 
 60% Compact TKL Layout for Maximum Desk Space

 The Apex Pro Mini features a 60% compact layout that removes the numpad, function row, and navigation cluster to deliver a keyboard footprint that is dramatically smaller than a full-size board. The result is significantly more desk space for wide mouse movements — a direct competitive advantage in FPS and battle royale titles where large, sweeping gestures are essential for accurate aim.

 Despite the smaller footprint, every essential key remains accessible through intuitive function layer shortcuts , ensuring you never feel limited by the compact design. Overview:

 FREEDOM THROUGH FORM 

 Compact enough for any space, and versatile enough for all setups—this is the BlackWidow V3 Mini Green Switch Phantom Pudding. Enjoy seamless gaming in a sleek package with a wireless 65% mechanical gaming keyboard that’s the perfect balance of form and function.

 65% FORM FACTOR 

 For Sleek, Compact Performance

 Without a function row, home cluster and numpad, this keyboard is similar to a 60% keyboard but with one key difference—it still has arrows keys. By keeping more functionality while still staying compact, the Razer BlackWidow V3 Mini HyperSpeed is ideal for minimalist or smaller setups where desk space is a premium.

 RAZER HYPERSPEED WIRELESS TECHNOLOGY 

 For Low-Latency Wireless Gaming

 Razer BlackWidow V3 Mini Green Switch Phantom Pudding wireless 65% mechanical gaming keyboard comes armed with our most advanced wireless technology for low-latency gaming and hyper-responsive inputs—made possible through an optimized data protocol, ultra-fast radio frequency and seamless frequency switching in the noisiest, data-saturated environments. With our multi-device support, streamline your setup by connecting your wireless mouse and keyboard to a single dongle—a feature that can be activated in our latest Razer HyperSpeed peripherals.

 RAZER HYPERSPEED MULTI-DEVICE SUPPORT 

 Streamline your setup and free up a USB port by connecting your wireless mouse and keyboard to a single dongle—a feature that can be activated in our latest Razer HyperSpeed peripherals.

 RAZER MECHANICAL SWITCHES 

 Razer BlackWidow V3 Mini Green Switch Phantom Pudding wireless 65% mechanical gaming keyboard is available in two variants:

 RAZER GREEN MECHANICAL SWITCHES 

 Hear and feel the satisfying feedback in every keystroke you make, with a clicky, tactile design that offers optimized actuation and reset points for better precision and performance when gaming.

 RAZER KEYCAPS WITH SIDE-PRINTS 

 Pair your choice of switch with one of two options that both have side-printed secondary functions for easier reference when executing commands and hotkeys.

 DOUBLESHOT ABS KEYCAPS 

 Using a doubleshot molding process to ensure the labelling never wears off, the keycaps also have extra-thick walls which make them extremely tough to withstand prolonged, repeated use.

 UPGRADE TO RAZER PHANTOM KEYCAPS 

 Whether you want a discreet look or a brighter RGB glow for your setup, our unique design lets you have both. With translucent sides to let more light through, these keycaps bring out the full brilliance of Razer Chroma™ RGB, while sporting a stealthy black look when off.

 UP TO 200 HOURS OF BATTERY LIFE 

 Enjoy long-lasting performance in Razer BlackWidow V3 Mini Green Switch Phantom Pudding regardless of whether it’s in Razer™ HyperSpeed Wireless or Bluetooth mode, and minimize downtime with charging that goes from zero to full in just under 5 hours.

 POWERED BY RAZER CHROMA RGB 

 With 16.8 million colors and a suite of effects, sync Razer BlackWidow V3 Mini Green Switch Phantom Pudding per-key lighting with the rest of your battlestation, and enjoy greater immersion as it dynamically reacts with over 150 integrated games.

Technical Specifications

 True 8kHz Polling Rate: Boasts an 8000Hz USB polling rate paired with 256kHz key-position scanning, reducing latency to a near-instantaneous 0.125ms.
 GravaStar x Gateron Magnetic Jade Pro Switch: Engineered for 0.005mm precision with adjustable trigger depth (0.1mm–3.5mm) to eliminate lag and enhance control.
 Adjustable Actuation Point: Customizable trigger depth (0.1mm increments, 0.1mm–3.5mm) to suit playstyles—shallow for fast combos, deep for precise inputs.
 Dynamic Rapid Trigger: Dynamically adjusts activation/deactivation points based on key travel (not preset limits), enabling fluid rapid-fire key repeats.
 Last Keystroke Prioritization (LKP) + Snap Click: Prioritizes the last-pressed key for smooth directional changes; resolves simultaneous presses by favoring deeper inputs.
 Rapid Trigger Mode: Eliminates key "stiction" with instant reset on upward travel, enabling faster re-presses and input switching.
 Semi-Aluminum Construction: Combines a sturdy aluminum frame (for durability) with a premium plastic base (lightweight, modern desk aesthetic).
 Hot-Swappable Design: Allows switch swapping (no soldering) with magnetic Hall Effect switches; compatible with select TTC and Gateron models.
 5-Layer Acoustic Foam: Minimizes keystroke vibrations for crisper sound and smoother typing feel.
 16 Modes, Dual Systems, Multi-Zone RGB Lighting: Customizable 16 dynamic modes, dual-zone control (keys + ambient side lights), and adjustable hue/saturation/brightness. 

 Warranty Information

 12-Month Limited Hardware Warranty

igeek-1k68wlr.description:
RAZER HUNTSMAN V3 PRO TENKEYLESS 
 FOR THE PRO 
Embrace a new standard of speed with the Razer Huntsman V3 Pro Tenkeyless. Sporting a leaner TKL keyboard layout for seamless competitive play, get the edge for esports with our latest analog optical switches, featuring adjustable actuation and Rapid Trigger Mode for ultra-fast repeated inputs.

 RAZER™ ANALOG OPTICAL SWITCHES GEN‑2 
 Rapid Trigger and Adjustable Actuation 
Max out on precision and response with a TKL keyboard featuring our most advanced switches, including Rapid Trigger for ultra-fast repeated inputs, a 0.1 to 4.0 mm adjustable actuation range, and a 100-million keystroke lifespan.

 RAPID TRIGGER MODE 
Release and repeatedly press keys at a much faster rate than is physically possible on standard keyboards. With the ability to reset keys at the slightest lift of a finger, experience an advantage in speed that is especially useful for movement in first and third-person games.

 ADJUSTABLE ACTUATION 
Supporting a full range of actuation from 0.1 to 4.0 mm, customize the switches to be as sensitive as you want and achieve a setting that best suits your playstyle.

 40 G ACTUATION FORCE 
Enjoy greater response with a lighter actuation force that lets you play and react quicker than ever before. From counter-strafing to aiming to dodging, gain a split-second advantage you need to come out on top in every exchange.

 QUICK ONBOARD ADJUSTMENTS 
 Via an LED Array Indicator 
Make precise, on-the-fly adjustments to actuation height or Rapid Trigger sensitivity with the visual aid of an onboard LED array. Save the settings to the keyboard and get access to greater customization through Razer Synapse.

 QUICK ACTUATION ADJUSTMENT MODE 
Simply hit FN + Tab to begin adjusting the keyboard’s actuation point. Next, press any key to test its actuation height and use the digital dial or arrow keys to adjust accordingly. Press Esc to exit the mode and save your settings to the onboard memory.

 QUICK RAPID TRIGGER ADJUSTMENT MODE 
Simply hit FN + Caps Lk to begin adjusting Rapid Trigger settings and press Caps Lk to toggle Rapid Trigger Mode on or off. Next, press any key to test your current Rapid Trigger settings and use the digital dial or arrow keys to adjust accordingly. Press Esc to exit the mode and save your settings to the onboard memory.

 MULTI-FUNCTION DIGITAL DIAL & DEDICATED CONTROL BUTTONS 
 Convenient Control 
Manage it all right at your fingertips with a dedicated dial for volume and analog switch settings, backed by a pair of buttons for media control and custom macros.

 TEXTURED DOUBLESHOT PBT KEYCAPS 
 Greater Resilience and Feel 
Made to withstand the wear and tear of intense competitive play, their shine-resistant design and fadeproof legends offer a degree of durability superior to regular keycaps.

 TENKEYLESS FORM FACTOR WITH ALUMINUM TOP PLATE 
 Smaller Footprint and Greater Durability 
Get more room to maneuver your mouse with a streamlined TKL keyboard layout that can also take a punishment, thanks to a solid, warp-resistant casing fitted with a brushed aluminum top plate.

 MAGNETIC FIRM LEATHERETTE WRIST REST 
 Extended Gaming Support 
Designed to seamlessly snap to the keyboard, the leatherette wrist rest provides firm ergonomic support for your wrists—especially vital for long periods of training and competition.

 Dominate the competition with the SteelSeries Apex Pro TKL Gen 3 Wired Mechanical Gaming Keyboard - Black , a tenkeyless powerhouse engineered for esports precision and compact performance. Powered by OmniPoint 3.0 Adjustable HyperMagnetic switches with Hall Effect Sensor Gen 3 technology, it offers 20x faster actuation (0.1mm–4.0mm adjustable, 40 actuation levels) and 11x quicker response, perfect for rapid inputs in games like Apex Legends or Valorant.
